headword: {口頭|こうとう}{発表|はっぴょう}

definitions.explanation: Used in academic, business, and educational contexts.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}の{口頭|こうとう}{発表|はっぴょう}の{準備|じゅんび}をしている。
examples.english: I'm preparing for next week's oral presentation.

examples.japanese: {学会|がっかい}で{口頭|こうとう}{発表|はっぴょう}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: I gave an oral presentation at the academic conference.

examples.japanese: {口頭|こうとう}{発表|はっぴょう}の{時間|じかん}は{一人|ひとり}{十五分|じゅうごふん}で、その{後|あと}{五分間|ごふんかん}の{質疑|しつぎ}{応答|おうとう}がある。
examples.english: Each oral presentation is 15 minutes long, followed by a 5-minute Q&A session.

notes:
Composed of {口頭|こうとう} (oral, verbal) + {発表|はっぴょう} (presentation, announcement). Refers specifically to presentations delivered by speaking, as opposed to written reports or poster presentations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口頭|こうとう}{発表|はっぴょう}を{行|おこな}う: to give an oral presentation
- {口頭|こうとう}{発表|はっぴょう}の{準備|じゅんび}: preparation for an oral presentation
- {口頭|こうとう}{発表|はっぴょう}{審査|しんさ}: oral presentation evaluation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プレゼンテーション: presentation (loanword, broader usage, common in business)
- {研究|けんきゅう}{発表|はっぴょう}: research presentation (content-focused rather than format)
- ポスター{発表|はっぴょう}: poster presentation (format contrast)
- スピーチ: speech (more general, not necessarily academic)
